photo 0 and photo 2 (PS4 Slim packaging design with PS logo and PS4-style graphics)

claims.claim: Such as FIFA and PES 2027 and others.
claims.evidence: No FIFA/PES game discs, covers, or screenshots of installed games are shown.

risks.risk: Games may not be included (or may be installed digitally with an account that can’t be transferred).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the full list of the 10 games on the PS4 (Games library screen) OR photos of the 10 game discs/cases.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a PS4 Slim console only (no confirmed games).

risks.risk: Console may have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, missing ports, controller drift).
risks.proof: Short video of the console powering on, reaching the home screen, and playing a game OR running a disc test; plus a controller input test showing no drift.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working beyond basic power-on.

risks.risk: Controllers shown may be non-original/third-party or may have issues (buttons/analog drift).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the controller model/label and ports, plus a video showing analog sticks and buttons responding correctly.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controllers are used/possibly third-party and not fully verified.

risks.risk: Packaging/“customised” look may be cosmetic; console condition could be poor (scratches, repairs, missing accessories).
risks.proof: Photos of all sides of the console, the back ports, and what accessories are included (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories are incomplete unless shown.

proof_requests: Send a photo/video of the PS4 home screen → Games library showing the exact 10 games.
If discs are included: show all 10 disc cases/discs laid out clearly (front and back).
Show what accessories are included (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable) with photos.
Send a short power-on + gameplay/disc test video to confirm it works.
response.reason: The photos confirm a blue PS4 Slim console and controllers, but the key value claims (10 games, including specific titles) and working condition are not verifiable from the images. Proof is needed before pricing confidently.
